:::{#exr-epe-reducible-sources}
#### Which sources of error a better method can reduce

Make the assumptions of @exr-epe-three-sources.
Which of the three quantities
(the squared [bias](#def-prediction-bias), the [variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-variance) of $\predvalf{\predvar}$, and the [population variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-variance) $\varpar$ of the [noise](#def-noise))
can a better [prediction](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) method reduce,
and which cannot?

:::
